motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, the bundle of routine items handled together in a single vote.

motions.summary: The council appointed Lacie Messerly to serve as Eagle Mountain's city recorder.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 2.45 regarding Youth Council.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 2.45 regarding Youth Council with updated revisions made in Work Session. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Rewrite the rules for the city's Youth Council
motions.summary: The council updated the section of city code that governs the Youth Council, including revisions worked out earlier in the same meeting.
